name: @isa/desktop
author: ISA Indústria de Alimentos e Temperos

scripts.start: npm run compile && npm run copy-web && node scripts/run-electron.mjs
scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run copy-web && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:dir: npm run compile && npm run copy-web && electron-builder --win --dir
scripts.release: npm run compile && npm run copy-web && electron-builder --win --publish always
